ffmpeg-core.js and ffmpeg-core.wasm: @ffmpeg/core 0.12.10 (ffmpeg.wasm, https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm),
the ESM build (dist/esm), unmodified. npm integrity of the package tarball:
sha512-dzNplnn2Nxle2c2i2rrDhqcB19q9cglCkWnoMTDN9Q9l3PvdjZWd1HfSPjCNWc/p8Q3CT+Es9fWOR0UhAeYQZA==
It is FFmpeg (libavcodec, libavformat, libswscale ...) compiled to WebAssembly, configured with --enable-gpl
(libx264, libx265 and others), so the package is licensed GPL-2.0-or-later. FFmpeg's sources and licence terms:
https://ffmpeg.org/legal.html. The player uses it only to decode video codecs Safari can't (decoders-ffmpeg.js).
